## Overview

Tabinator is an AI-powered guitar tab generator that transcribes songs into accurate, playable tabs tailored to a user's skill level. Instead of hunting through broken community uploads, users simply enter a song and artist, select their skill level, and get a clean, readable tab instantly.

The app is designed for casual guitar learners who want to spend more time playing and less time searching.

**Core features:**

- AI-generated tabs customized for Beginner, Intermediate, or Advanced skill levels
- Personal tab library — saved tabs persist to a user account
- Support for different tunings (standard, drop D, custom)
- Sectional generation (intro, verse, chorus) for longer songs

## Core User Flow

1. Sign up / log in via Supabase Auth
2. Enter a song title and artist
3. Select a skill level
4. Claude generates a plain-text ASCII tab with playnotes
5. Tab is saved to the user's library in Supabase
6. View and revisit saved tabs from the dashboard

## Technical Details

**Stack**: React + Vite + Tailwind CSS

**Database & Auth**: Supabase (Postgres with Row Level Security, Supabase Auth)

**AI**: Anthropic Claude API — generates ASCII tablature with a JSON metadata block

**Deployment**: Vercel

**Key decisions:**

- Web-first UX optimized for desktop practice sessions
- AI-first generation — no crowdsourced edits for MVP
- RLS enforced on all tables; users can only access their own tabs
- Tabs stored as plain-text ASCII alongside a JSON metadata block for structured querying
- Duplicate detection via hash of (song + artist + skill + tuning)
